vocab.sentence: People are advised to stay home as much as possible to minimize the risk of catching the disease.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 建議大家盡量待在家裡，以降低感染疾病的風險。

vocab.sentence: As long as you follow the procedures I've told you, it won't be difficult to get this task done.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 只要按照我告訴你的步驟進行，完成這項任務就不會很困難。

vocab.sentence: Anyone who wants to enter this construction site needs to put on a protective helmet first.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 任何想進入這個工地的人，都必須先戴上防護頭盔。

vocab.sentence: The police have set up a number of barriers to prevent crowds of people from entering the square.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 警方設置了許多路障，防止人群進入廣場。

vocab.sentence: Diana's uncle has a real passion for camping and plans to open a store selling camping equipment.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Diana 的叔叔非常熱愛露營，並計畫開一家販售露營裝備的商店。

vocab.sentence: The athlete is undergoing hard training because he is aiming at winning a place on the national team.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這名運動員正在接受嚴格訓練，因為他的目標是取得國家代表隊的一席之地。

vocab.sentence: We are all ordinary people with our own particular failings; in other words, no one is perfect.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們都是各有缺點的普通人；換句話說，沒有人是完美的。

vocab.sentence: The mechanic told us that it was a faulty part that caused the machine to break down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 技師告訴我們，是一個有瑕疵的零件造成機器故障。

phrases.sentence: The super spy has the ability to successfully carry out the secret mission.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那名超級間諜有能力成功執行祕密任務。

phrases.sentence: Ricky violated the new safety rule that has just been put in place.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Ricky 違反了剛實施的新安全規定。

phrases.sentence: On her way home, Wendy went to a supermarket to buy some vegetables, fruit, meat, and so on.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Wendy 回家途中去超市買了一些蔬菜、水果、肉類等等。
